factors: Eight claims span format affordances, reported reviewer experience, accessibility and browser execution boundary.
The owner requested a source-grounded comparison with counterevidence and a falsifiable human-review test.
complexity.rationale: A short practitioner essay can support proportionate analysis of the strongest use cases and counterargument without invented productivity statistics or a universal format verdict.

sourceMap.rationale: The mapped opening differentiates the author’s personal Markdown reading friction and examples from any unmeasured outcome claim.
The mapped comparison preserves the author’s explicit Markdown caveat while GhostMesh proposes a versioned source and view.
The mapped section attributes interactive examples to the source and labels browser execution or network controls as external documentation and GhostMesh inference.
The mapped visual capability is qualified by W3C accessibility guidance; the Reader does not claim the original examples passed an accessibility audit.

sourceCoverage.rationale: Four distinct sections map the practitioner essay’s opening, visual and interactive examples, Markdown caveat and editing workflow. No fictitious video timeline is used.

supportingArgument.rationale: The argument for HTML’s visual comparison, browser sharing and exportable interaction is represented sympathetically before judging outcomes.

evidenceRoles.rationale: Personal experience, format specifications, accessibility guidance, browser-security documentation and proposed GhostMesh experiments are distinguished.

counterargument.rationale: Markdown’s plain-text portability and diffable source role receive a concrete alternative, including the risk of drift in a dual-record workflow.

tradeoffs.rationale: The essay weighs richer engagement against version identity, accessibility, remote dependencies, scripts and maintenance burden.

falsifiability.rationale: A matched reviewer study with defects, accuracy, time, accessibility, offline behavior and export integrity could alter the format recommendation.

originalSynthesis.rationale: GhostMesh treats the page as a versioned review surface that must expose source, alternative, behavior and accountable choice rather than as proof by polish.

performance.rationale: The source gives no measured comprehension or review-speed result; the proposed test measures decision accuracy and time for short and visual tasks separately.

economics.rationale: The source concerns document review and presentation, not a material price or total-cost claim; maintenance work is addressed as a workflow tradeoff.

threatGovernance.rationale: The Reader identifies sharing, script, resource, accessibility, provenance and export boundaries without alleging any security incident in the source examples.

decisionRationale: Independent review and targeted source-link follow-up found no actionable defect on the exact article and source-map hashes. Tony has not qualitatively accepted these bytes; authenticated acceptance and a separate production decision are still required.
